molecular_mechanism: Disrupts proximal GATA1 binding motif (AGATAA→AGACAA): abolishes erythroid-specific ACKR1 transcription. ACKR1 is uniquely regulated by an erythroid-specific GATA1 site in the proximal promoter. The c.−67T>C mutation eliminates GATA1 binding, silencing expression on red blood cells while non-erythroid expression (endothelium, Purkinje neurons, kidney) is preserved via a GATA1-independent alternative promoter.
